Retour à la liste

Temps plein
Type de contrat :
Independant

Description de l'entreprise
ATCON is a Belgium-based IT consulting firm established with a vision to empower businesses using the latest technologies and provide best-in-class services to our clients.
We support as an end-to-end IT solutions partner for digitalizing business processes and making the data meaningful.
Our approach is more solution-driven than technology one, focused to solve business challenges and deliver results. We do what is right for our clients and charge based on what we deliver not on billing hours.
Our team consists of self-motivated consultants with an agile mindset, global work exposure, and commitment to deliver the best services.
Description de la fonction
You will be working in the context of the National Control Center (Ncc) in the Netcalc Domain. The Ncc is the beating heart of the day-to-day electricity management in Belgium. The Netcalc Domain is where we model the Grid, build scenarios and do risk analysis. Working in this context is something to be proud of because you are actively contributing to keeping the lights on; literally!
As you are playing such a key role in managing the Grid day to day and learning to work in this context requires a serious effort, we are looking for a Business Analyst who feels the energy to stay on board for at least three years, learning, improving and contributing.
Service description
Business process modelling:
You have a strong passion for business process modelling and you are convinced of the importance of modelling business processes, where expertise and clarity matter more than buzzwords.
Your confidence in your approach is essential. You understand the difference between a business process and an application process.
You can show case the ability to Analyse End-to-end business Processes and model Business processes in a structured and effective way, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and BPMN Methodology.
You can take a step back and analyse existing Business Processes for improvements.
You understand how business processes realize capabilities and are willing to explore together with our business architect ways to improve Elia's business architecture.
Information modelling:
In the energy market, accurate information modelling is essential for ensuring that complex data structures reflect real business needs and support critical market processes.
As a Business Analyst, you are responsible for structuring and representing business concepts clearly and consistently. This includes modelling information using UML class diagrams while remaining sharp and willing to challenge existing concepts.
You should be able to introduce new business concepts, when necessary, propose precise definitions, review and refine existing ones, and work in a structured, concise manner to maintain clarity and alignment across systems.
You understand the link between capabilities, information ownership and information models.
Requirements gathering & analysis:
Responsible for eliciting, clarifying, and prioritizing Stakeholder and solution requirements both functional and non-functional, in close collaboration with stakeholders and development teams within an Agile framework.
This includes facilitating workshops, refining user stories, and ensuring that requirements are well-understood, actionable, and aligned with business objectives.
The role demands adaptability, continuous stakeholder engagement, and the ability to challenge assumptions constructively to deliver value-driven solutions.
You work closely with the Product Owner to define and refine the backlog.
Solution design & validation:
Collaborate closely with the Solution Architect, understanding where your responsibilities end and theirs begin-without stepping into their role.
Work together toward shared goals, while constructively challenging proposed solutions to ensure they meet business requirements and objectives in a sustainable, future-proof manner, without "sitting in their chair."
In addition, you represent and safeguard the business architecture during solution design, monitoring that the implementation remains aligned with business principles and strategic objectives.
Testing & quality assurance:
Together with the Agile team, you take ownership of parts of testing activities to ensure quality and alignment with business...
...
